title: Thai Crumble Fried Chicken
description: A unique twist on traditional fried chicken, inspired by the flavors of Thailand. This dish combines crispy fried chicken with a crunchy mediterranean crumble topping and a tangy yogurt sauce.
instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, mix together flour, eggs, and a pinch of salt.
2. Dip each piece of chicken into the flour mixture, coating completely.
3. Place the coated chicken on a plate or tray.
4. In a large skillet or Dutch oven, heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
5. Add 3-4 pieces of chicken to the skillet and fry until golden brown, about 5-7 minutes.
6. Remove the fried chicken from the skillet and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. Repeat the frying process with the remaining chicken pieces.
8. To make the mediterranean crumble topping, mix together panko breadcrumbs, a pinch of salt, and a few grinds of black pepper.
9. Sprinkle the crumble topping over the fried chicken.
10. To make the yogurt sauce, mix together 1/2 cup of yogurt, 1 tablespoon of honey, and a pinch of salt.
11. Drizzle the yogurt sauce over the top of the fried chicken.
